description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to Demand & Levy on Import Duty undenatured Ethyl-alcohol and Ethyl alcohol etc. from 25.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification contains a Revenue Protection Order issued by the Minister of Finance under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It establishes new customs duty rates on specific imported articles (ethyl alcohol and spirits), making it a regulatory instrument that modifies existing legal frameworks. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
